name: 34652 · New Prt Rchy, FL
findings: ZIP 34652 (New Prt Rchy) has 91 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34652 (New Prt Rchy) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 17 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
